g.text: Load the Northwind XML feed through the same `load`…
run the ready leaves under this one
release a running leaf; send back one in review;
ends a search, a selection, a pane
plan first on or off: a session proposes a tree
fold or unfold here (on the goal: all)
the record: who held it, what changed,
accept a proposal; sign off a leaf in review;
widen its scope to what it wanted
edit it with what is under it, as text
a sibling leaf for that, which it waits on
wait on the leaves its reason names
the planner splits it into leaves
ask the planner (elsewhere ? is this help)
undo your last act on the plan
select several, then y or d
any graphene command, as you would type
quit; a run started here goes on
Every key is a graphene command, and the bottom line says which it ran. Two agents work here: the planner
proposes the tree (a session, or :ask), the executors do its leaves (R, r).
E edit with what is under it
